_doc: PR-D (2026-05-30) — user-facing strings for the 5-tab Settings IA (Overview / AI Setup / Knowledge Index / Tools / Advanced). Loaded via TemplateManager.loadJson(ConfigTemplateId.Settings). Vocabulary contract: Profile→Provider, Quick→Fast Lookup, Deep→Research, Premium/online tier→Use stronger model when needed, Embedding→Knowledge Index, Web Search slot→Web Access, MCP Servers→External tools, Permission mode→Safety, Agent Harness→Agent runtime. The word "Harness" is allowed ONLY inside the Advanced tab. Edit values freely; the Settings UI falls back to DEFAULT_SETTINGS_STRINGS in src/ui/view/settings/settingsStrings.ts if any key is missing.

backend.info: Which loop engine runs agents. The in-process runtime sits on top of Vercel AI SDK and supports any Provider (Claude, GPT, Ollama, OpenRouter). The Claude Agent SDK runtime is Anthropic’s official SDK (Anthropic models only). Vault Search currently requires the Claude Agent SDK runtime until its tools are adapted.
backend.fieldHint: Picks the loop engine; per-tier model selection is via Tier Bindings below.

options.auto: Auto (in-process where supported, Claude Agent SDK for the rest)
options.harness: In-process runtime (Vercel AI SDK, any Provider)

tierBindings.info: Pick which model serves each tier. The Fast Lookup and Research tiers usually use local Providers (Ollama); the “stronger model” tier usually uses cloud Providers (Anthropic, OpenRouter). Unset tiers are skipped when the runtime cascades.

fastTier.label: Fast Lookup (local)
fastTier.hint: Single-step replies, ~1s (works well with 14B local models)

researchTier.label: Research (local)
researchTier.hint: Multi-step reasoning / long documents (works well with 32B+ local models)

strongerTier.label: Use stronger model when needed
strongerTier.hint: Cloud model used as the fallback when local tiers are not enough

escalation.allowFieldHint: Auto-upgrade to the next tier on low confidence
escalation.thresholdFieldHint: Escalate when step score falls below this (0–1)

safety.fieldHint: Controls how agents handle write operations to your vault.

hooks.description: Hook configuration DSL is not yet available. This section will allow defining deny rules and command hooks for pre_tool_use / post_tool_use events.
